fields.name: Front
fields.purpose: Recognition card front. HTML is allowed. Show the target expression prominently and include the source Japanese sentence.

fields.name: Back
fields.purpose: Recognition card back. HTML is allowed. Include reading, meaning, part of speech, the Japanese sentence, and English translation.

fields.name: Tags
fields.purpose: Space-separated Anki tags. Include wakaru, part of speech, and concise topic tags.
